approval.note: A composed script is a draft. A human reads it before this film is published anywhere.

script.vo01: Research knowledge accumulates faster than any team can read it, so a discovery question gets answered from the part of the corpus somebody happens to remember. Internal innovation submissions arrive in very different shapes, and comparing them fairly is hard when each one has been written to its own standard.
script.vo02: Today that picture is assembled by hand, one system at a time.
script.vo03: It reads Research corpus and technical literature, Experimental records. It engages you in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams. And it can reason across the research corpus to answer a discovery question, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: A researcher asks what the corpus says about alternative binders. The agent reasons across the literature and the experimental record, and returns the candidates with the studies behind each one.
script.vo05: Asked for an experimental plan, the agent proposes a sequence that tests the cheapest assumption first, names the measurement that would settle each question, and says what a negative result would mean.
script.vo06: On risk, the agent surfaces the failure modes the literature reports, distinguishes findings that replicated from those that did not, and marks where the evidence runs out.
script.vo_payoff: Researchers bring the whole corpus to a question instead of the part they happen to recall.
script.vo_helps: The result? More of the corpus brought to each question, more complete submissions, and one evaluation standard applied consistently.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
